    return ZZ(1) if bool(c) else ZZ(0)
def tm(n, k, x): return (-1)^k/(factorial(k)*factorial(k+n))*(QQ(x)/2)^(2*k+n)
instances = [
    oracle_instance('0', '1', '_',
                    lhs=tm(0, 0, 1),

                    rhs=2*(5+1)/(-2)*tm(5+1, 0, -2), relation='==', edge=False),
